question: Narendra Modi Cricket Stadium is one of the premier stadiums in India located at __________.
solution:
The correct answer is **Ahmedabad**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Narendra Modi Cricket Stadium** is located in **Ahmedabad**, Gujarat.
 
• It is also known as the **Motera Stadium**.
 
• The stadium is the largest cricket stadium in the world with a seating capacity of over 110,000 spectators.
 
• It was inaugurated by the President of India on **24 February 2020**.
 
• The stadium is home to the Gujarat Cricket Association.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 Feature
 Description
 
 
 
 

 **Design**
 The stadium's design includes a unique bowl-shaped structure with no pillars, ensuring an unobstructed view for spectators.
 
 

 **Facilities**
 It features state-of-the-art facilities, including four dressing rooms, a clubhouse, an Olympic-sized swimming pool, and a gymnasium.
 
 

 **Events**
 Besides cricket, the stadium has also hosted various cultural and political events.
 
 

 **Records**
 The stadium has witnessed several record-breaking performances, including international cricket matches and IPL games.
 
 

 **Renovation**
 The stadium underwent major renovation and expansion work starting in 2016 and was completed in 2020.
